issues.description: The specification/UML defines the Lecture attribute `numberOfTutors` as type `int`, but the reference solution declares it as `short`. This type mismatch can cause students to implement an `int` field (per UML) while tests/reference expect a `short`, and it also leads to inconsistent API typing in the solution (getter returns `int`, setter/constructor accept `short`).
issues.suggestedFix: Align the solution with the UML by changing `numberOfTutors` to `int` everywhere in the solution: field declaration, constructor parameter, and setter parameter; keep getter/setter both using `int`.
